description: A shell script for configuring and installing Kubernetes components on GCE COS instances, including downloading binaries, setting up container runtimes, and configuring system components.

methods.name: set-broken-motd
methods.description: Sets a message of the day indicating Kubernetes node setup is in progress or broken.

methods.name: get-metadata-value
methods.description: Fetches a value from GCE metadata server, with optional default.

methods.name: download-kube-env
methods.description: Downloads kube-env configuration from GCE metadata.

methods.name: download-kubelet-config
methods.description: Downloads kubelet configuration file from GCE metadata.

methods.name: download-kube-master-certs
methods.description: Downloads master certificates from GCE metadata.

methods.name: validate-hash
methods.description: Validates file integrity using sha1 or sha512 hash.

methods.name: get-credentials
methods.description: Retrieves default service account credentials token.

methods.name: valid-storage-scope
methods.description: Checks if VM has appropriate GCS storage scopes.

methods.name: download-or-bust
methods.description: Downloads a URL repeatedly until success, validating hash if provided.

methods.name: download-robust
methods.description: Downloads a URL with retries and exponential backoff.

methods.name: is-preloaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific file is preloaded based on preload info.

methods.name: split-commas
methods.description: Splits comma-separated string into lines.

methods.name: remount-flexvolume-directory
methods.description: Remounts a directory with bind and exec options.

methods.name: install-gci-mounter-tools
methods.description: Downloads and installs GCI mounter tools.

methods.name: install-node-problem-detector
methods.description: Downloads and installs node problem detector binary.

methods.name: install-cni-binaries
methods.description: Downloads and installs CNI binaries.

methods.name: install-crictl
methods.description: Downloads and installs crictl binary.

methods.name: install-kube-manifests
methods.description: Downloads and unpacks Kubernetes manifests.

methods.name: try-load-docker-image
methods.description: Attempts to load a docker image file multiple times.

methods.name: load-docker-images
methods.description: Loads kube-system docker images.

methods.name: ensure-containerd-systemd-service
methods.description: Creates systemd service for containerd.

methods.name: install-containerd-binary
methods.description: Downloads and installs containerd binary from GitHub.

methods.name: install-runc-binary
methods.description: Downloads and installs runc binary from GitHub.

methods.name: install-containerd-ubuntu
methods.description: Installs containerd on Ubuntu, optionally skipping apt.

methods.name: install-containerd-cos
methods.description: Installs containerd on COS.

methods.name: install-auth-provider-gcp
methods.description: Downloads and installs GCP auth provider binary and config.

methods.name: ensure-containerd-runtime
methods.description: Ensures containerd runtime is installed and configured.

methods.name: install-kube-binary-config
methods.description: Downloads and sets up Kubernetes binaries and manifests.

methods.name: detect_host_info
methods.description: Detects host platform and architecture.

methods.name: retry-forever
methods.description: Retries a command forever with delay.

methods.name: log-init
methods.description: Initializes logging variables.

methods.name: log-trap-push
methods.description: Sets an EXIT trap for logging.

methods.name: log-trap-pop
methods.description: Restores previous EXIT trap.

methods.name: log-error
methods.description: Logs an error step in bootstrap process.

methods.name: log-wrap
methods.description: Wraps a command with bootstrap logging.

methods.name: log-start
methods.description: Logs start of a bootstrap step.

methods.name: log-end
methods.description: Logs end of a bootstrap step.

methods.name: log-proto
methods.description: Outputs a log proto message.
